changes.comment: A provider ref listed under the wrong kind in config.json (for example a `builtin:codex` agent-runtime provider referenced from a `channels[]` entry) now fails config validation with a `RuleViolation` naming the actual and expected kind, instead of the provider package loader's own contract error. This follows from built-in providers now registering their descriptor and implementation together as always-loaded plugins (R9): the mismatch is caught once, in config validation, for both built-in and `npm:` provider refs. No behavior change for a correctly configured install.
